chunks: Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but a messenger of God, and the seal of the prophets. God has knowledge of everything.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Prophet being called the 'Seal of the Prophets' and how does adoption affect lineage in Islam?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in the context of the marriage to Zaynab bint Jahsh, definitively severs the legal ties of adoption (kafala) to allow for the new marriage, thereby abolishing the pre-Islamic custom of treating an adopted son as a biological son. It establishes the Prophet's unique status as 'Khatam an-Nabiyyin' (Seal of the Prophets) and highlights the divine wisdom behind this social reform, which was crucial for the integration of early Muslim society.
